_meta.notes: Form header reads '2020 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' but this is the 2024 cycle (filed 06/18/24; electronic signature 06/18/24 12:25 PM) - form_year recorded verbatim as 2020. Typed county grid throughout, NOT handwritten (chunk-file handwriting prior does not apply to this document). Schedule A runs p3-p11 (15 rows/page except 6 on p11), Schedule B p12-p16 (14/14/14/14/10). The Complete Mailing Address column is fully black-barred on every Schedule A page - donor city/state/zip do NOT survive (all blank, 'redacted at source'); the bar never touches name/date/occupation/amount. The printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS/EXPENDITURES cells repeat the filing grand total on every page. Occupation/Employer printed for 24 of 126 contribution rows (mostly larger donors; includes 'NA' for committees); the remaining 102 cells are empty (filer left blank - noted per row). Five cells are clipped by column edges in the source PDF (transcribed as the visible glyphs, needs_review): C p8r7 'Democratic Party Black C', C p9r4 'ends of Rosalba Doming', E p14r13 'ose Park Community Coun' + purpose 'Rose Park Street Festival Vendo', E p14r14 'Proof H', E p15r14 'lt Palace Convention Cent'. Schedule A is not in strict date order on p9 and p11 - transcribed in printed order. Chunk-file priors confirmed at the page: c_rows 126 (marked approx) and e_rows 66 both exact; stated totals match.
